argumentDescriptions.ActivateObjects.objects[].type: Object type: an ADT type code (either case), or a name standing for one (in brackets after it): CLAS/OC (class), INTF/OI (interface), PROG/P (program), PROG/I (include), FUGR/F (functiongroup), FUGR/FF (function, functionmodule, function_module, func), FUGR/I, DEVC/K (package), DDLS/DF (view), VIEW/DV (dbview), TABL/DT (table), TABL/DS (structure, stru), TTYP/DA, DOMA/DD (domain), DTEL/DE (dataelement), DCLS/DL, BDEF/BDO, DDLX/EX, SRVD/SRV, SRVB/SVB, DSFD/SCF, DSFI/SFI, XSLT/VT, FTG2/FT, AUTH, ENHO/XHH, ENHO/XHB, ENHS/XSB, PROG/PX, CLAS/OCX. One object alone may also be named function_group, ddl, data_element, behavior_definition, metadata_extension. PROG/PX is a program's text elements, or with parentName a function group's; CLAS/OCX is a class's text elements; each is activated together with its object when both are named. A name is written in lower case: view is a CDS view (DDLS/DF). A value in upper case is a code, a main type or a search name of the system's object types list first, so VIEW is the dictionary views (VIEW/DV); it is a name only when it is none of these (CLASS is class). A main type, the part of a code before its slash, stands for its code when exactly one listed code has it. In upper case, a search name of the system's object types list stands for the listed code its list item has (e.g. STRU for TABL/DS).
argumentDescriptions.ActivateObjects.preaudit: Request pre-audit before activation. Default: true. Sent as preauditRequested on both paths, single-object activation and group activation. With true a system may answer the objects still inactive and activate nothing; sending them again with false is the next call. These codes and kinds (either case) and names (lower case) take single-object activation: CLAS/OC, PROG/P, INTF/OI, FUGR/F, TABL/DT, TABL/DS, DDLS/DF, DOMA/DD, DTEL/DE, BDEF/BDO, DDLX/EX, function_group, ddl, data_element, behavior_definition, metadata_extension, class, program, functiongroup, interface, table, structure, domain, dataelement, view, stru. So does a main type or a search name standing for one of these codes; any other call is a group activation.

descriptions.HandlerActivate: Activates an ABAP class, program, include, interface, function group, table, structure, table type, CDS view, domain, data element, behavior definition, metadata extension, package, service definition, service binding, function module, behavior implementation, program text elements, function group text elements or class text elements, another object by its ADT type, or several objects together by an activation run.
descriptions.HandlerCheckRun: [read-only] Checks the syntax of an ABAP class, program, interface, function group, function module, table, structure, table type, CDS view, domain, data element, package, behavior definition or metadata extension, as stored or as the source given.
descriptions.HandlerCreate: Creates an ABAP package, domain, data element, transport, table, structure, table type, CDS view, service definition, service binding, class, program, include, interface, function group, function module, behavior definition, behavior implementation or metadata extension, inactive where it is activated.
descriptions.HandlerDelete: Deletes an ABAP package, domain, data element, table, structure, table type, CDS view, service definition, service binding, class, CDS unit test, program, include, interface, function group, function module, behavior definition, behavior implementation, metadata extension, local test class, class local types, class local definitions, class local macros or class unit test, a class include under the class's lock. Over Streamable HTTP it runs under the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header).
descriptions.HandlerDeletionCheck: [read-only] Checks whether SAP lets an ABAP package, domain, data element, table, structure, table type, CDS view, service definition, service binding, class, CDS unit test, program, include, interface, function group, function module, behavior definition, behavior implementation or metadata extension be deleted.
descriptions.HandlerGet: [read-only] Reads the source code, metadata, contents, structure or unactivated change of an ABAP package, domain, data element, table, structure, table type, CDS view, service definition, service binding, class, local test class, class local types, class local definitions, class local macros, program, include, interface, function group, function module, behavior definition, behavior implementation, metadata extension, class unit test, CDS unit test, transport, table technical settings, program text elements, function group text elements or class text elements, or the status and results of an activation run. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. By default the run goes on after the call, and its result comes back under the run_handle the call gives; with background false the result comes back in the call.
descriptions.HandlerLock: Locks an ABAP class, program, include, interface, function group, function module, table, structure, table type, CDS view, domain, data element, package, behavior definition, behavior implementation, metadata extension, service definition, service binding, table technical settings, program text elements, function group text elements or class text elements for its update, delete and unlock on the server instance that holds the lock. Over Streamable HTTP the state_handle it gives goes with every later call: send it as the state_handle argument of every call (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header).
descriptions.HandlerProfileRun: Runs an ABAP class or an ABAP report, under a scheduled profiler trace when its profiler id is given. target_type CLASS: runs an ABAP class implementing if_oo_adt_classrun and gives its console output. target_type PROGRAM: runs an ABAP report and gives its output.
descriptions.HandlerUnlock: Unlocks an ABAP class, program, include, interface, function group, function module, table, structure, table type, CDS view, domain, data element, package, behavior definition, behavior implementation, metadata extension, service definition, service binding, table technical settings, program text elements, function group text elements or class text elements, releasing the lock this server instance holds. Over Streamable HTTP it runs under the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header).
descriptions.HandlerUpdate: Updates an ABAP package, domain, data element, table type, function group, table, structure, CDS view, service definition, class, local test class, class local types, class local definitions, class local macros, class unit test, CDS unit test, program, include, interface, function module, behavior definition, behavior implementation, metadata extension, service binding, table technical settings, program text elements, function group text elements or class text elements, under its lock. Over Streamable HTTP it runs under the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header).
descriptions.HandlerValidate: [read-only] Validates the name of a new ABAP class, program, include, interface, function group, function module, table, structure, table type, CDS view, domain, data element, package, behavior definition, behavior implementation, metadata extension or service binding, before it is created.

Runs on an ABAP session of its own. By default the run goes on after the call, and its result comes back under the run_handle the call gives; with background false the result comes back in the call.

descriptions.HandlerActivate: Activates an ABAP class, interface, function group, table, structure, table type, CDS view, domain, data element, behavior definition, metadata extension, package, service definition, service binding, function module, behavior implementation, program text elements, function group text elements or class text elements, another object by its ADT type, or several objects together by an activation run.
descriptions.HandlerCheckRun: [read-only] Checks the syntax of an ABAP class, program, interface, function group, function module, table, structure, table type, CDS view, domain, data element, package, behavior definition or metadata extension, as stored or as the source given.
descriptions.HandlerCreate: Creates an ABAP package, domain, data element, transport, table, structure, table type, CDS view, service definition, service binding, class, interface, function group, function module, behavior definition, behavior implementation or metadata extension, inactive where it is activated.
descriptions.HandlerDelete: Deletes an ABAP package, domain, data element, table, structure, table type, CDS view, service definition, service binding, class, CDS unit test, interface, function group, function module, behavior definition, behavior implementation, metadata extension, local test class, class local types, class local definitions, class local macros or class unit test, a class include under the class's lock. Over Streamable HTTP it runs under the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header).
descriptions.HandlerDeletionCheck: [read-only] Checks whether SAP lets an ABAP package, domain, data element, table, structure, table type, CDS view, service definition, service binding, class, CDS unit test, program, include, interface, function group, function module, behavior definition, behavior implementation or metadata extension be deleted.
descriptions.HandlerGet: [read-only] Reads the source code, metadata, contents, structure or unactivated change of an ABAP package, domain, data element, table, structure, table type, CDS view, service definition, service binding, class, local test class, class local types, class local definitions, class local macros, program, include, interface, function group, function module, behavior definition, behavior implementation, metadata extension, class unit test, CDS unit test, transport, table technical settings, program text elements, function group text elements or class text elements, or the status and results of an activation run. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. By default the run goes on after the call, and its result comes back under the run_handle the call gives; with background false the result comes back in the call.
descriptions.HandlerLock: Locks an ABAP class, interface, function group, function module, table, structure, table type, CDS view, domain, data element, package, behavior definition, behavior implementation, metadata extension, service definition, service binding, table technical settings, function group text elements or class text elements for its update, delete and unlock on the server instance that holds the lock. Over Streamable HTTP the state_handle it gives goes with every later call: send it as the state_handle argument of every call (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header).
descriptions.HandlerProfileRun: Runs an ABAP class, under a scheduled profiler trace when its profiler id is given. target_type CLASS: runs an ABAP class implementing if_oo_adt_classrun and gives its console output.
descriptions.HandlerUnlock: Unlocks an ABAP class, interface, function group, function module, table, structure, table type, CDS view, domain, data element, package, behavior definition, behavior implementation, metadata extension, service definition, service binding, table technical settings, function group text elements or class text elements, releasing the lock this server instance holds. Over Streamable HTTP it runs under the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header).
descriptions.HandlerUpdate: Updates an ABAP package, domain, data element, table type, function group, table, structure, CDS view, service definition, class, local test class, class local types, class local definitions, class local macros, class unit test, CDS unit test, interface, function module, behavior definition, behavior implementation, metadata extension, service binding, table technical settings, function group text elements or class text elements, under its lock. Over Streamable HTTP it runs under the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header).
descriptions.HandlerValidate: [read-only] Validates the name of a new ABAP class, interface, function group, function module, table, structure, table type, CDS view, domain, data element, package, behavior definition, behavior implementation, metadata extension or service binding, before it is created.
